articles.title: Man sells son’s forgotten Pokemon cards for $2M after keeping them in attic for 15 years
articles.snippet: A retired decorator in the UK has become a millionaire after selling a collection of Pokemon cards for nearly $2.1 million, having kept them in his attic for 15 years.

articles.snippet: Following on from Krispy Kreme’s Pokemon collection, Mister Donut stores across Japan are now releasing their own sweet treats to celebrate the creature-collecting game’s 30th anniversary.
